meta_description: Zoom Electrical Nottingham. Expert electrical installation, rewiring, and testing. Reliable service across Nottinghamshire. Call 07356 209989.
hero_subhead: From new circuits to complete rewires, we get your Nottinghamshire home safely wired and up to standard.
services_subhead: Whether you need a new socket, a full rewire, or an urgent repair, Zoom Electrical has the expertise and speed to get it done right.

services.title: Full House Rewiring
services.desc: Complete electrical system overhaul to meet modern safety standards. We test, certify, and leave you with peace of mind and a new EICR certificate.

services.title: New Circuits & Socket Installation
services.desc: Add sockets, USB points, or dedicated circuits for appliances without overloading your system. Clean, safe installations with a 25-year guarantee.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Replace old fuse boxes with modern dual RCD consumer units. Improves safety, gives you more circuits, and reduces the risk of tripping.

services.title: Fault Finding & Repair
services.desc: Tripped electrics, flickering lights, or dead outlets? We diagnose the fault quickly and fix it the same day, most jobs under £200.

services.title: Electrical Testing & Certification
services.desc: EICR inspections for landlords, surveyors, and peace of mind. Full report with remedial works quoted and carried out on site.

services.title: Outdoor & Garden Electrics
services.desc: Garden lighting, hot tub installations, and shed circuits. All work IP-rated and weatherproof, with RCD protection as standard.

about_pullquote: Every job done as if it were my own home — safely, fairly, no hidden costs.
about_para_1: Zoom Electrical was founded in Nottingham over 12 years ago by a frustrated sparky tired of seeing customers ripped off by cowboys. From a one-man van, we've grown to a reliable team serving West Bridgford, Beeston, and across Nottinghamshire. We're NICEIC Registered and carry full public liability insurance — your work is always covered and certified.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on straightforward pricing, honest diagnostics, and getting jobs done on time. Most of our new customers come from word-of-mouth — and we're proud that around 60% of our work is from repeat clients or their friends. We turn up when we say we will, explain what's needed in plain English, and stand behind every job with a guarantee.
reviews_heading: What Nottinghamshire Homeowners Say About Zoom Electrical

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. Had a dodgy socket that was sparking and was worried it'd be an expensive job. The lad came out same day, found the issue in the consumer unit, and sorted it for a fair price. Very professional and explained everything clearly. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: We needed the whole house rewiring and were dreading the upheaval. Zoom Electrical worked around our schedule, kept disruption to a minimum, and finished bang on time. The team were respectful and tidy. Got our EICR cert in the post within a week. Top job.
reviews.author: Nicola M.

reviews.text: Called for an emergency — my bathroom electrics had blown and I had guests arriving. They came within the hour, diagnosed a faulty extraction fan, and replaced it. Professional, no faffing about, and reasonably priced. Exactly what you want in a sparky.
reviews.author: James T.
